meta.title: Event -> field reasoning - SignalsListView
meta.description:
## Event -> field reasoning - SignalsListView

This read model (and its Signals List screen) intentionally sits AFTER the Auto-Assign Signal automation column, not next to Signal Captured. Signal Captured itself stays in an earlier column because it has to - it is what opens the Unmatched Signals todo list that triggers Auto-Assign Signal. But the screen a person actually looks at reflects state accumulated by the time they open it, i.e. after the automation has already had a chance to run.

- **Signal Captured** -> sets signalId, sender, sourceApp, body, receivedAt. Stand-in for the already-implemented MVP Capture pipeline (see notify_mvp_plan.md), not modeled on this board.
- **Signal Assigned To Project (auto instance, Auto-Assign Signal's column)** -> sets assignedProject (latest value). This is what makes Dave's already-assigned row legitimate: it is fed forward from the automation, not backward-linked.
- The manual Signal Assigned To Project (later column, the Assign Signal to Project slice) is NOT connected here - it is later than this read model's column, so it cannot feed it without violating forward-only ordering. A signal a person manually assigns updates via the next time this screen is queried in a later occurrence, not retroactively on this instance.

Consumed by both Signals List (this column, list cardinality) and Assign Signal to Project (single-item context display, one column further right).
